digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review bot / code review criterion system
propositions: A live Gerrit dogfood probe must validate that the deployed review bot loads the review-phase-boundaries criterion from the rebar repository and executes it through the four-pass pipeline without offline mocking.
The positive-control patchset adding the discovery/evidence refinement must emit no project-criterion finding, and historical patchset abstaining must be preserved as a stimulus-limitation baseline.

The predeclared RP-F2 FIRE-control patchset must produce a project-attributed advisory finding with reviewer_id=code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria=[project.review-phase-boundaries], with recorded Pass-2 validity and impact and Pass-3 priority and decision values.
The final cleaned patchset submitted to main must retain only phase-compliant instructions, emit no finding from the project criterion, and be the sole probe revision merged.
